title: Research ethics and consent
goals: Explain the mechanism and terminology of research ethics and consent
Apply the stated procedure to a new case with a traceable result
Identify an assumption or limitation and design a revealing follow-up
vocabulary: Restricting use to the authorised purpose
The cost or risk imposed on participants

blocks.text: Proposal automatically copies student essays into a study because they were submitted for grading.
The grading purpose does not establish research permission under the policy. Redesign around fictional data or obtain required review and voluntary permission before collection.

guided_practice.title: Trace the worked case
guided_practice.prompt: Proposal automatically copies student essays into a study because they were submitted for grading. Show the intermediate steps and give the conclusion with its scope.
guided_practice.answer: Teacher explanation: The grading purpose does not establish research permission under the policy. Redesign around fictional data or obtain required review and voluntary permission before collection.

independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: A fictional policy requires opt-in; proposal treats silence as agreement and grades participation. Audit.
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: Silence is not opt-in; grading participation undermines voluntariness. Use non-participation without penalty and required review.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
This classroom policy exercise does not determine real legal or institutional requirements.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.

blocks.text: Use fictional records for this course. For the supplied classroom policy, a real study needs responsible review, plain-language purpose, opt-in consent and withdrawal handling before collection. Do not implement real recruitment in this exercise.

blocks.text: Before applying the procedure, write its units, denominator or decision boundary where relevant. A partner should be able to repeat each step using the same inputs. If a required input is absent or violates the stated contract, record that condition explicitly instead of quietly replacing it with a convenient value.
